rationale: window_host.hpp: WindowOptions::MenuCommand gains a defaulted app_menu_section field (commands | after_about) so the macOS standalone application menu can place Check for Updates directly under About. Additive and defaulted: every existing aggregate and designated initializer keeps its meaning, and the field is ignored for named menus. It exists for Pulp's standalone plug-in host's Sparkle updater (pulp_add_sparkle), which is Pulp-specific audio app integration; no retained-UI kernel behaviour, view-tree, layout or render authority moves.
